thread:
Sam T: Hey finance — noticed two charges from HotelBerl on my corporate card for the same stay: EUR420 (posted) and another EUR420 showing as a separate posted txn. Ramp shows both so it looks like a double-bill. Also audit flagged a lost taxi receipt from BER for EUR34 (I paid cash). What do you need to dispute the hotel and get reimbursed for the taxi?

Nina G: Hi Sam — sorry for the hassle. Can you DM me the last 4 of your card and attach screenshots of the card transactions + the hotel folio? For the lost taxi receipt we accept a manager attestation for amounts <= EUR50. If taxi > EUR50 we need a manager + expenses attestation form.

Sam T: Card last4: 2934. Uploaded screenshots and the hotel folio (folio.pdf) to the Ramp expense thread. Taxi was EUR34 exactly, paid cash at arrival. I added an attestation note in Ramp: "I lost the taxi receipt, paid cash, request reimbursement."

Finance Bot: Automated reminder: disputes must be raised within 60 days of transaction date. To file a chargeback we need merchant name, txn ids or screenshots, and your card last4. If a manual reimbursement is requested, include manager approval and bank last4 for ACH.

Carlos P: I approve the EUR34 taxi reimbursement for Sam (manager approval). Sam, please add route details (airport -> HotelBerl) and approximate time.

Sam T: Route: BER Terminal 1 -> HotelBerl, ~09:15 local time on 2026-02-18. I added that in the Ramp notes and reattached the attestation.

Nina G: Thanks. We'll open a vendor dispute with HotelBerl via Ramp and also file an internal request for a provisional manual reimbursement for the taxi under the lost-receipt policy. Creating ticket FIN-2026-400. If the dispute resolves in our favor and the card is credited, we'll cancel the manual taxi payout to avoid duplication.

Payroll Ops: For the taxi ACH we need Sam's bank last4 to verify. We can do an ad-hoc ACH (2 business days) or include in next payroll cycle. Which do you prefer?

Sam T: Ad-hoc please — bank last4: 5577. Need the funds for receipts I submitted.

Finance Bot: FIN-2026-400 created and assigned to Nina G. Estimated vendor response time: 7-14 business days. Payroll Ops flagged for ad-hoc ACH payout.

Nina G: Dispute opened with HotelBerl and Ramp; reference IDs attached to FIN-2026-400. Note on VAT: if hotel reverses the charge, we'll receive a full reversal including VAT and our tax reclaim will be adjusted. If they instead issue a separate credit, we'll reconcile and process as needed.

Sam T: Quick policy q: should I have booked the taxi via corporate card/Uber for VAT reclaim? I usually do cash to pay drivers.

Nina G: Ideally use corporate card or company Uber for automatic VAT capture. Cash taxi receipts can be tricky for VAT reclaim unless the receipt includes vendor VAT info. We'll add a short tip to travel docs.

(10 days later)

Sam T: Update — Ramp just posted a credit for EUR420 from HotelBerl (appears as reversed txn). I presume dispute worked. Can you confirm and cancel the taxi manual payout if needed?

Nina G: Confirmed — we see a credit posted to the same card. FIN-2026-400: vendor refunded. We're canceling any duplicate manual reimbursement for the hotel. The EUR34 taxi payout is still valid and will be processed to bank last4 5577 via ad-hoc ACH today.

Finance Bot: FIN-2026-400 status: Closed.

Payroll Ops: ACH for EUR34 initiated (ref PAY-2026-789). Expect 2 business days. Sam, please confirm when funds land and mark the Ramp expense resolved.

Sam T: Got the ACH today, EUR34 received. Marking resolved — thanks all :rocket:
